## ICT Support and Test Engineers (nec)
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented ICT Support and Test Engineer to join our team and play a key role in maintaining the integrity, performance, and quality of our systems and infrastructure. This role combines technical support, quality assurance, and systems testing to ensure seamless operations and adherence to established standards. The ideal candidate brings a methodical approach to problem-solving, strong communication skills, and a solid foundation in ICT systems and environments. This position suits an experienced professional who thrives in a collaborative setting and is committed to delivering high-quality technical outcomes.
## Key Responsibilities
- Schedule and conduct quality audit inspections across systems, data, and documentation, identifying variations and potential high-risk areas to ensure continued adherence to established standards and procedures.
- Investigate, diagnose, and resolve system problems and performance issues, providing hands-on troubleshooting support for desktops, hardware, software, printers, databases, operating systems, email platforms, and network connectivity.
- Test the functionality, behaviour, and integrity of systems and application code within defined testing protocols and quality frameworks, identifying and documenting errors, faults, and deviations from specification.
- Develop, implement, and maintain quality assurance processes, guidelines, and strategies to support system reliability, security, and performance across the organisation.
- Recommend and facilitate corrective action plans to address non-compliance issues identified through ongoing monitoring, auditing, and review of operational processes and procedures.
- Perform organisational systems architecture reviews and assessments, providing well-informed recommendations on current and future hardware and software strategies aligned with business needs.
- Develop and deliver technical guidance, training, and support to end users and stakeholders on application software, operational procedures, and best practice usage.
- Communicate and liaise effectively with users and management to promote awareness of quality control standards, data integrity requirements, and ICT compliance obligations.
- Create, review, and maintain comprehensive technical documentation including procedural guides, operational manuals, technical specifications, testing reports, and maintenance inventory records.
- Assist in the planning and execution of system upgrades, installations, configurations, and patch management activities to minimise disruption and maintain system availability.
- Monitor and evaluate system infrastructure to proactively identify risks and opportunities for improvement, contributing to the ongoing optimisation of ICT environments.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams and project stakeholders to support the delivery of ICT initiatives and ensure quality outcomes are achieved throughout the project lifecycle.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline; or equivalent demonstrated experience in a similar ICT role.
- Proven experience in ICT technical support, systems testing, or quality assurance within a professional environment.
- Strong understanding of testing methodologies, quality assurance frameworks, and audit processes across systems and software.
- Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across a broad range of ICT systems, including hardware, software, operating systems, and network components.
- Experience developing and maintaining technical documentation such as test plans, procedural guides, specifications, and operational manuals.
- Solid knowledge of database management, system security, backup procedures, and infrastructure performance monitoring.
- Proficiency in diagnosing software and hardware faults and delivering appropriate solutions within agreed timeframes and service levels.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured, methodical approach to quality assurance and issue resolution.
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team, managing competing priorities and deadlines effectively.
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant industry certifications such as ITIL Foundation, CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, ISTQB (Software Testing), or Microsoft Certified qualifications.
- Experience with enterprise-level systems, cloud platforms, or virtualisation technologies such as AWS, Azure, or VMware.
- Familiarity with IT service management (ITSM) tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or Zendesk.
- Exposure to Agile or DevOps delivery environments and associated testing practices such as continuous integration and automated testing.
- Previous experience conducting formal ICT audits, architecture reviews, or compliance assessments.
- Knowledge of relevant Australian and international ICT standards and frameworks, including ISO/IEC 27001 or COBIT.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth.
- Access ongoing learning and development opportunities, including support for professional certifications and industry training.
- Enjoy a flexible work environment with options for hybrid working arrangements to support work-life balance.
- Contribute to meaningful, large-scale ICT projects that have a real impact on organisational performance and service delivery.
- Competitive salary package with opportunities for career progression within a growing and dynamic technology function.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

Purpose of position
To ensure smooth and efficient functioning of the practice and provide an exceptional standard of care to our patients.

Responsibilities 

Clinical
•	Perform clinical duties within required level of clinical competency, according to best available evidence.  Explain procedures to patients, providing them with support and reassurance.  Duties include triage, immunisations and other injections; wound management, chronic disease management, ECG’s and collection of pathology samples.  Assist doctors with clinical procedures.  Maintain clinical documentation.
•	Oversee cold chain process, awareness, responsibilities and documentation of cold chain process.
•	Monitor infection control standards and implement changes / educate.

Patient Services
•	Assist with triage, data management, diagnostic services, networking with other providers, planning & management of patient care and patient advocacy.  Telephone patients with test results as directed by medical staff.  

Improvement of Patient Health Outcomes
•	Conduct preventative/screening procedures; assist with patient education and community health promotion activities.  Co-ordinate patient recall and outreach programs and GP management plans and team care arrangement.  

Equipment and Supplies
•	Maintain stocks of clinical supplies, including correct storage (such as refrigeration), removal of out-of-date stock and ordering supplies.  Provide input in purchasing relevant clinical equipment and supplies.
•	Assist with stock ordering bi – monthly
•	Assist with monthly vaccine order
•	Complete daily job allocation sheet
•	Check emergency trolley daily
•	Check O2 therapy as per job description
•	Monitor cold chain process twice daily

Compliance
•	Maintain awareness of current and new legislation to ensure business is complying with all statutory and regulatory obligations including infection control, sterilisation, hazardous materials & safe handling/disposal of medical waste, records management, OHS, and accreditation.  Ensure relevant personnel are kept informed and changes are made to systems and procedures as required.  

Professional
•	Act within the practice and nursing code of ethics & appropriate level of clinical competence at all times.  Maintain awareness of current evidence and research on clinical practices and inform/educate other practice staff. Change systems and procedures to ensure compliance with best available evidence as applicable.  

OHS
•	Consistently be aware of OHS requirements and comply with them.

General
Delegation of tasks to other medical and non-medical staff. 
Assist with other practice duties as required.  

Expected behaviours and personal attributes 
•	Demonstrate a knowledge of and compliance with all relevant legislation and common law obligations affecting nursing.
•	Discharge of duty of care in the course of practice including meeting practice standards, and accountability for nursing actions.
•	Demonstrate knowledge of policies and procedural guidelines that have legal implications, for example, ensure documentation conforms to legal requirements.
•	Practice only within the limits of their educational preparation and competence.
•	Identify and respond to unsafe practice, for example, implement interventions to prevent unsafe practice and/or contravention of law.
•	Demonstrated patient-focused approach in service provision with genuine empathy and interest in their needs.
•	Excellent interpersonal and communication skills across all ages and social groups.
•	Be always well presented, friendly, courteous and obliging.  Represent the practice in a confident and positive manner at all times. 
•	Undertake all duties in a diligent manner, with honesty and integrity, 
•	Maintain absolute confidentiality regarding patient and practice information.
•	Have a vigilant attitude to accuracy, being prepared to double check as necessary.
•	Ability to work cooperatively and independently. & ability to prioritise and organise, with attention to detail.
•	Demonstrated commitment to ongoing professional development
•	This position requires physical ability to occasionally lift and/or move patients.
•	Possession of current driver’s licence (include only if essential to perform job, such as home visits)

Education, Qualifications and Experience  
Essential:
•	Appropriate tertiary qualification & registration certificate. 
•	Professional indemnity cover.
•	Minimum of one year of nursing experience, preferably in a community-based role.
•	Demonstrated understanding of the needs of general practice and interest in community-based nursing including patient education and health promotion.
•	Knowledge of current immunisation schedules, Diabetes management, asthma management, enhanced primary care items, infection control, CPR and emergency resuscitation techniques, equipment & drugs.

Desirable:
•	Competence in the use of relevant equipment & software – be specific, give brand-names if appropriate. 
•	Experience in similar role as practice nurse or community-based nursing.
•	Experience with specific social groups serviced by practice, such as adolescents, aged care, migrant or refuge groups, aboriginals & Torres Straight islanders, etc.
•	Additional qualifications such as Accredited Women’s Health Certificate, Diabetes Education Certificate, Asthma/Spirometry qualification/education.
•	Member of APNA.

Hours Of Work
As per fortnightly roster 
Weekend & Public Holiday work as rostered   
However it is expected that our staff will work extra time on occasions if this is required to deliver essential patient care.
Breaks:  30 minutes for lunch and 10 minutes each for morning and afternoon tea to be taken in shifts with other staff to ensure continuity of care. 

Other features: 
 
Professional development provided or expected.
Requirement for use of own vehicle, if essential to the position.
Potential for contact with hazardous material such as blood & body fluids.
May be required to have some immunisations.
